## Verifiable Project Portfolio

### 1. GEHU Connect (Flagship Campus Application)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/gehu-connect
- Type: Production Mobile Application (Android, iOS)
- Status: Deployed and actively used by roughly 1,000 students at Graphic Era Hill University
- Architecture:
  - Client: React Native with Expo single codebase pipeline
  - Backend API: Spring Boot in Java exposing REST endpoints for auth, profiles, communities, and the campus feed
  - Media Storage: Cloudflare R2 via the AWS SDK, keeping uploads off the application server
  - Focus: Built around unreliable campus Wi-Fi, fast sign-up reliability, and consolidating scattered student notices

### 2. Netwich (macOS Multi-Interface Link Bonding)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/netwich
- Source Repository: https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Netwich
- Type: Native Desktop Utility (macOS 14 or later)
- Status: Completed and released
- Stack: Swift 6, SwiftUI, SOCKS5, Apple `IP_BOUND_IF`
- Highlights: Local SOCKS5 proxy at `127.0.0.1:1080` binding outgoing TCP sockets across Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and USB phone tethering using adaptive weighted least-connections placement, continuous RTT/throughput EWMA health scoring, and byte-range chunked downloads.

### 3. ARANYA (Geospatial Wildlife Conflict Intelligence)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/aranya
- Source Repository: https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Project-Aranya
- Prototype: https://project-aranya.vercel.app
- Type: Geospatial Web Platform
- Pilot: Rajaji-Corbett corridor, Uttarakhand, India
- Focus: Reconciles sparse field observations and camera-trap records to map habitat change, movement patterns, and conflict hotspots.

### 4. ORVESS-PAT (Optical Tracking & Free-Space Optical Communication Simulation)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/orvess-pat
- Type: Simulation Suite in Python (ISRO Smart India Hackathon exploration)
- Focus: Focal-plane array sensor modeling, sub-pixel centroiding, observation quality scoring, adaptive filtering, and Monte Carlo noise sweeps.

### 5. Meghavyuha (Adaptive Weather Intelligence)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/meghavyuha
- Deployment: https://meghavyuha.vercel.app
- Type: TypeScript Web Application
